description: Business Admin and control pages: Overview home, Classes Timetable and Closures, Insights, Revenue, Policies, Staff (create accounts), Import issues, Reports, read-only Grading, and Notifications for both roles. Covers R80-R96 (plan.md section 1D). Depends on FEAT-001..003 (uses ledger, rosters, followups, exceptions, policies).
steps: Read FEAT-001..003 findings and plan.md R80-R96. Read admin.js renderSessions/openSessionForm/delete modal/grading/promote, notify.html + notify logic, reports.html, portal.css .bars/.spark.

Create admin_portal/admin-business.js (loaded on BA-only pages and the BA home). index.html: for Business Admin render Overview: period selector, Organisation / Today at HQ switch (Today reuses renderToday from admin-desk.js), four .stat cards (Active members, New members without conversion %, 90-day retention, Collected vs outstanding) from data, 'Centres at a glance' rows linking to insights.html?centre=, 'Waiting on you' (exceptions, payment failures, import issues, promotion results, follow-up outcomes) with 'Low attendance flags' pointing to followups.html, four business question cards (open another class / why newcomers leave / classes needing attention / did intervention work) with Explore buttons; no 'newcomers not joining' card.

sessions.html: complete the BA Timetable tab (existing recurring-class table moved here; add effective start/end, mat, bookable online shown as HQ yes / non-HQ no, NFC code; clash check on save: same instructor/time, same mat/time, closure); keep Delete with confirmation showing upcoming bookings affected and lessons returned (D5); wording 'Session = weekly plan, Class = dated occurrence'. Add Closures tab (data-ba): close HQ for a date range or cancel one class, list affected students, return lessons, write DB.closures so Rosters show Cancelled. Edit admin.js renderSessions/openSessionForm in place.

Create admin_portal/insights.html: shared filter bar (period, compare-to, centre, class type, time slot, age group, belt group) and tabs Centres & classes, Capacity (with 'Plan a pilot slot' opening the session form pre-filled), Needs attention (banner: investigate first, never auto-cancel), Retention, Experience & teaching, Interventions (log with before/after and continue/adjust/stop). No Newcomers tab, no cost figures. Figures derived from CLASSES, FEEDBACK, DB.cohorts, DB.interventions, labelled 'Sample data'. Use .bars/.spark/.tbl/.fpill only.

Create admin_portal/revenue.html: month total received, breakdown by item, outstanding, failed payments list, Export CSV, no reconciliation/cost; DEBUG PANEL placeholder comment already placed on payments (R40) so add a second only if Revenue hosts it. Create admin_portal/policies.html: tabs Packages & prices, Booking rules, Auto-activation rules, Approved payment methods (Stripe), Notification templates, Follow-up triggers writing DB.policies; each save opens an impact modal before applying; verify Payments take-payment and registration Activate read the saved values.

Create admin_portal/staff.html: staff table (name, ID, role, status, last sign-in), drawer to change role, reset password (mock), deactivate/reactivate; Create account for Instructor, Admin (front desk) or Business Admin generating ADM-1xx / ADM-0xx / INS-xxxx IDs into DB.staff; block deactivating self or the last Business Admin; deactivated accounts get the sign-in message from FEAT-001. Create admin_portal/imports.html: DB.imports list with failed/incomplete reasons and unmatched names, Fix (pick a member) and Dismiss; DEBUG PANEL placeholder comment for a sample CSV import.

grading.html: make read-only per D4: remove Schedule and Approve/Confirm controls, show applications and instructor results with statuses, keep one 'Apply result (demo)' button per result that calls the existing promote() so the student promotion chain still works; add DEBUG PANEL placeholder comment for grading pass/fail. Keep admin.js promote() and ensure the instructor submit -> admin list -> student home chain still works.

reports.html: add date range and centre filters, exports for attendance, progression, real payment records (ledger rows with member, item, date, amount, method, status) and follow-up outcomes; BA-only page.

notify.html: rewrite audience per role: Admin gets 'HQ class' and 'One student' only with a required approved template (templates from DB.policies); Business Admin additionally All members, One dojo, By grade; preview count computed from MEMBERS; Sent history card from DB.sentLog for both; All members and By grade radios carry data-ba. Remove placeholder wording about HQ closures per R01.

Create .admin-fix-tmp/verify/verify-feat4.mjs asserting R80-R96 per plan.md 5.3; screenshots at 1280 and 390 for every BA page and for notify as Admin and BA, plus drawers/modals (staff create, policy save, closure). Run all verify-feat*.mjs and regress; fix failures. Record findings: policy keys, DB.staff/imports/interventions shapes, any additive CSS rules added.
acceptance_criteria: BA Overview shows the four stat cards, Centres at a glance, Waiting on you and four question cards (none about newcomers not joining); 'Low attendance flags' opens followups.html; the Organisation / Today switch changes content.
Timetable save is blocked on an instructor/time clash; delete modal reports affected bookings; a closure marks matching rosters Cancelled and returns lessons.
Insights has six tabs and no Newcomers tab; 'Plan a pilot slot' opens the session form pre-filled; Needs-attention banner text is present.

Revenue total equals this month's paid ledger rows; Policies save shows an impact modal and a changed price shows in Take payment; Staff create adds an account that can sign in through signin.html, deactivation blocks sign-in with the deactivated message, last Business Admin cannot be deactivated; Imports fix/dismiss reduces the open count.
Grading page has no Schedule/Approve controls; 'Apply result (demo)' promotes through promote() and the student home still shows the promotion.

Admin (FD) cannot open insights, revenue, grading, reports, policies, staff, imports (redirect with 'That page is for Business Admins'); notify as Admin has no All members or By grade; five 'DEBUG PANEL' placeholder comments exist across the admin HTML.
No horizontal overflow at 390px on every BA page; no console errors.
findings: VERIFIED: verify-all passes: feat1 125, feat2 104, feat3 152, feat4 146, regress 17, 0 failures. Nothing staged or committed. FILES: new admin-business.js (Overview, Closures, Insights, Revenue, Policies, Staff, Imports, Reports, Notifications; globals prefixed bz/cl/ins/rev/pol/stf/imp/rp/nf), insights.html, revenue.html, policies.html, staff.html, imports.html; rewritten admin.js (timetable, sessionClash, openSessionForm(i, preset), sessionMine, read-only renderGrading, promote kept; dashboard/notify/reports/openSchedule removed), index.html (BA #baHome Overview; admin-desk moves #fdHome inside it, hidden until 'Today at HQ'), sessions.html (Timetable columns, Closures tab), grading.html, reports.html, notify.html. admin-shell.js closureOn(date, cls) now also matches single-class closures {scope:'class', code, from}; classState uses it. admin-desk.js: setTab handles #tabClosures, roster note wording. portal.css additive: .list-bar > .filters {min-width:0; max-width:100%}. DB SHAPES: DB.closures rows gain students, lessons, code, label (class scope); rosters gain returned:true after lessons are given back. SESSIONS gain effFrom/effTo (ISO date strings or ''), mat, online, end. DB.staff new accounts {id,name,type,status,last:null}; IDs: Admin ADM-1xx, Business Admin ADM-0xx, Instructor INS-xxxx. DB.imports rows gain matchedNo when fixed. DB.interventions rows {id,name,slot,start,before,after,decision}. DB.policies: templates may grow (id T-xxxx), booking/followTriggers/autoActivation edited through impact modal. Grading: the only button is 'Apply result (demo)' calling promote(). DECISIONS: only HQ has weekly sessions in seed data, so Centres at a glance shows one centre; Staff role change is limited to Admin <-> Business Admin (instructor IDs would no longer match their sign-in tab); DEBUG PANEL comments: 6 comments cover the 5 kinds (clock is on both sessions.html and roster.html, kept because verify-feat2 asserts both); policies has no dogi price (DOGI_PRICE stays in admin-desk.js). SLIP: I briefly edited insights.html and reports.html with PowerShell Set-Content (adds a BOM); both were then rewritten with fs_write, so the final files have no BOM. Screens: ba-overview/overview-today/timetable/closures/insights/insights-pilot/revenue/policies/policies-impact/staff/staff-drawer/imports/grading/reports/notify at 1280, fd-notify-1280, and ba-* 390 for every page.
